My dear [Mrs Warburton ](/person/1465)
A great many thanks for your kind present.[^1] It is my favourite period of history and I am sure [Mr Warburton ](/person/1466)will have treated it in a more kindred spirit than I think has been shewn in all the books of this series, some of which have disappointed me especially the Wars of the Roses, but I am sure I shall enjoy reading this.

Yours very sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: William Parsons Warburton, Edward III (1874). CMY was still recommending it in 1881: see Coleridge, Life, 56.

It appeared in the \'Epochs of Modern History\' series.
